title: Symplectic Stafford: Lean 4 formalization checkpoint
description: Lean 4 formalization checkpoint for the symplectic Stafford same-divisor programme. The repository proves the original-ring right-ideal bridge/action laws and support-boundary interfaces, explicit opposite transport, ordered common-colon/finite-generation and conditional support-union identities, raw and algebraic bounded filtered/Rees operations, quotient Rees-module actions, explicit power-Ore fractions, finite-support and matrix-pencil detection, conditional differential-Ore/right-denominator clearing, constructive finite-index successor and original-affine source-selection contracts, and the terminal zero-quotient/cofactor boundary, with a Mathlib-only Challenge/Solution pair. It does not claim the universal higher-dimensional source-selection or same-divisor theorem; Phase I and Phase II release gates remain explicit.
notes: A Zenodo DOI is intentionally absent until an authorized GitHub release is archived and Zenodo issues the identifiers. Machine checks and human mathematical review are separate gates.
